ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that quadrilateral $ABFE \sim$ quadrilateral $EFCD$, $AB=2$, and $EF=3$. What is the length of $DC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $ABFE\sim$ quadrilateral $EFCD$,\\
we have $\frac{AB}{EF}=\frac{EF}{CD}$,\\
Considering $AB=2$ and $EF=3$,\\
we obtain $CD=\frac{EF^2}{AB}=\boxed{\frac{9}{2}}$
